annotations.title: Is a company a fit for RZLT?

description: A quick, rule-based check of whether a company fits RZLT’s ideal client (technology companies, seed to Series C, €1M+ in revenue or funding). Fill in what you know; unknown fields can be left out. Returns a verdict (strong_fit, possible_fit, not_a_fit_yet), the reasons, services that match the goal, and the booking link.

goal.description: What they want to grow, in a sentence.

is_local_business.description: A business serving one town or region in person (a restaurant, a clinic, a shop).

is_tech_company.description: Is it a technology company (software, AI, hardware, deep tech, fintech…)?

revenue_or_funding_eur.description: Annual revenue or total funding raised, whichever is higher, in euros.

name: check_fit
title: Is a company a fit for RZLT?
